resources.string: Pick a demo file to begin — use "PICK DEMO" in the toolbar
Demo is %1$d MB — over the %2$d MB limit (Settings → Performance)
Detects instant 180° view or pitch flips within a single server tick — the signature of aim snapping.
Flags pitch angles outside the physically possible range (±90°); only hacks can look past the poles.
Detects repeated identical view angle deltas across ticks — human aim never repeats exactly.
Detects the aim snapping onto a target between two ticks, based on usercmd command batching.
Tracks per-player view angle history and flags statistically improbable rotation sequences.
Detects hits on enemies outside their legitimate hit window — the signature of time-shift (backtrack) cheats.
Detects two shots in one tick from non-automatic weapons, made possible by usercmd exploitation.
Detects triggerbot usage via anomalies in the +attack/-attack console command stream.
Detects attack button spans that overlap no legitimate +attack/-attack command window.
Aimsnap detection based on the input recorder data stream.
Detects silent aim: the shot direction deviates from the view angles sent to the server.
Detects psilent hacks: view angles corrected after firing to hide the aimbot snap.
Detects shots that ignore weapon spread — every pellet lands exactly on the aim point.
Detects instant 180° turns into a backstab crit, the signature of auto-backstab cheats.
Detects perfectly timed jumps that keep a consistent ground-touch duration — the signature of bunnyhop scripts.
Flags weapons whose equip region combination is impossible without client-side modification.
Return every algorithm switch and parameter to its default?

TF2 demo cheat-detection analyser — Android port of demo-analysis.

Analysis core: demo-analysis by Nocrex, fidoo and teltta (GPLv3): %1$s
Extended fork used as the analysis dependency: tf2-demo-player-aio: %2$s
